description: Winner of the City of Nanaimo Design Award in 2000, this neighbourhood pub anchors Longwood Station — the ten-acre, nine-building commercial hub the firm planned for the Longwood community, its buildings ranging from 4,000 to 44,500 square feet.
Entered at two levels on a steeply sloping site, the pub's spacious, lofty interior features impeccable detailing throughout, holding a luxurious yet casual atmosphere.
note: Photography for this project has not yet been recovered from the archives.
